name: Smith Machine Hack Squat
steps: Position the Smith bar across your upper back and take a shoulder-width stance slightly ahead of the rails.
Release the hooks, brace your trunk and keep your feet flat.
Bend your knees and hips smoothly to squat straight down until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive forcefully through your full feet to press back up to standing without locking your knees hard.
tips: Keep your feet far enough forward that your heels never lift as you reach the bottom of the squat.
Keep your knees tracking smoothly in line with your toes throughout each repetition.
